decisions.reason: The source explicitly revises the About page, not the FAQ, and the existing FAQ commission copy remains valid without stating an expiration policy.
Removing expiration from code-used commission earnings does not change the per-mint price or revenue-allocation amounts.
The no-expiration statement applies to commissions earned through a used referral code, not allocation when no code is supplied.
Commission earning expiration is independent of prize-ticket issuance and ticket-cycle expiration.
The commission earning-expiration rule does not change the referral code's identity, lifetime, sharing methods, or display surfaces.
The source change concerns code-used commission earnings and does not alter ticket allocation for mints without a referral code.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the About-page statement that referral earnings have no limits and no expiration.
Commission earning expiration does not affect the metadata counters, badges, or referral-code attribute source.
The commission earning-expiration change is independent of the unresolved prize delivery and claim-button behavior.
The no-expiration commission rule does not modify Big Block prize amounts, draw triggers, eligibility, or funding.
The no-expiration commission rule does not modify Small Block prize amounts, draw cadence, eligibility, or funding.
Commission earning expiration does not change either prize-ticket counter or its draw-based reset behavior.
